ThreadShelf Local Alternative rendering components

ThreadShelf Local Reader: bounded rich content parser, chart renderer,
rich layouts, message-scoped reference resolution, TeX source protection,
and deterministic Mermaid repair candidates.
Copyright (c) 2026 davoda1. MIT, see licenses/Reader-MIT.txt.
Adapted to an isolated browser bundle, with generated math links disabled and chart category labels moved below
negative-value labels to prevent overlap.

Marked 17.0.5: Markdown parser. MIT, see licenses/Marked-LICENSE.md.
MathJax 4.1.3 and MathJax TeX font 4.1.3: local TeX/MathML to SVG. Apache 2.0, see licenses/MathJax-LICENSE.txt and licenses/MathJax-Original-TeX-Font-LICENSE.txt. The v3 font package is build-time constant-data input only; no v3 executable runtime is shipped. See ../scripts/mathjax-vendor-lock.json and ../docs/MathJax-4.md.
Mermaid 12.2.0: local diagram renderer, shared with the Local Reader bundle.
Includes DOMPurify 3.4.17 and KaTeX 0.19.1. MIT for Mermaid itself;
see licenses/Mermaid-LICENSE.txt and the complete incorporated-component
notices/versions in licenses/Mermaid-BUNDLE-NOTICES.txt and
licenses/Mermaid-BUNDLE-MANIFEST.json. Reproducible source recipe and lockfile:
tools/mermaid-bundle/ in the suite repository.
No library requires network access for its supported bundled features.

highlight.js 11.12.0: offline code syntax highlighting. BSD 3-Clause, see
licenses/highlight.js-LICENSE.txt. The language adapter, Fish grammar, and
VS Code palette derive from Local Reader under its MIT license.
